summary: Frontend-only testing of TuntasUMKM Auth Page + Owner Dashboard (mock, localStorage). All 14 requested flows verified end-to-end via Playwright on preview URL. Core flows PASS: nav-login-link -> /auth, tab switch, form validation (email regex + password >=6 + confirm match), mock signIn, dashboard guard, sidebar navigation (5 tabs), approval approve/reject/history/empty state, inbox conversation switch + 7 trace stages, catalog search filter + empty state, both recharts render, logout redirect + guard, register mismatch blocked, mobile 390px nav toggle + no horizontal scroll on /auth. Only issue is a UX nit around HTML5 native email validation short-circuiting the custom auth-field-error for invalid-format emails (still blocks submit correctly).

ui_bugs.issue: Email input is type="email" without noValidate on <form>. When user submits an obviously-invalid email (e.g. 'notanemail'), the browser's native tooltip fires and our custom auth-field-error is never rendered. Submit is still blocked, but the spec explicitly states the error should appear via data-testid=auth-field-error. Fix: add noValidate to <form> or change input to type=text so the JS validate() path is exercised.

issues: Recharts logs 8 warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on initial render before ResponsiveContainer measures. Chart still renders correctly after layout. Consider giving parent an explicit min-height or aspect ratio to silence the warning.

action_items: Optional: add noValidate to <form data-testid=auth-form> (or switch email input to type=text) so that submitting with an invalid email format shows the custom auth-field-error message instead of the browser's native tooltip.
Optional: set min-height / aspect on Recharts ResponsiveContainer parent to silence width(-1) height(-1) warnings on Analytics tab first paint.
critical_code_review_comments: mockAuth.signIn falls back to email.split('@')[0] as display name when name is empty, so login always shows a value in dashboard-user-name - good.
OwnerDashboard guard uses getUser() at render then Navigate to /auth - correct and consistent.
All required data-testid attributes exist and are correctly wired via constants/testIds. approval-history-<id>, catalog-empty-state, logout-button-mobile all present.
No mixed-content or CORS issues since app is 100% mock/frontend as specified.
test_credentials: Auth is mock only: any valid-format email + any password >=6 chars, e.g. rina@warungsenja.id / rahasia123
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend is pure React + localStorage; no backend to test. All 14 review-request flows pass. Only nit is HTML5 native email validation intercepting the custom auth-field-error for invalid email format (submit is still correctly blocked).
